lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh my, it's been so long! Ten years, right?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What are you talking about? I saw you barely over a year ago because of that Black Freeza nonsense.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, right! Remember when I was Black? That was weird.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I dyed my hair for a bit.

lines.speaker: Goten
lines.text: And I stopped looking exactly like my dad!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Was that before or after we met Broly?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And then there was Jiren. Remember Jiren?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So did you guys ever beat Freeza?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Now let's take Pan to her first world tournament before GT inserts itself.
